1	# Change context (factual record, parent-prepared)
2	
3	## Intent and authority
4	- README.md (repo root): client and provider ship independently. Every merged client
5	  increment must support the released provider at Git tag `eval-release`, including
6	  ordinary settings saves while enhanced_settings is false. `provider/settings.py` at
7	  that tag is the supported provider source. A successful settings save means values
8	  were applied and the caller sees success. The candidate provider is not deployed and
9	  a pending provider task cannot change the supported baseline. (explicit)
10	- docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/design.md: ordinary saves must continue to work with
11	  the supported provider at eval-release; enhanced UI disabled by default; add an
12	  application receipt to the protocol in client and provider increments while
13	  preserving independently releasable main. (explicit)
14	- docs/feat/wip/enhanced-settings/implementation.md: Task 1 = client-side receipt
15	  handling + unit test; Task 2 = provider receipts in separate provider repository.
16	  Review only the client increment; shared delivery contract still applies. (explicit)
17	
18	## Change boundary
19	- Selector: staged changes (`git diff --cached`); no unstaged changes exist.
20	- Review base: HEAD ac09e55463b2d33bba4cdf6a759d759e3d80c024. Candidate: index.
21	  Worktree files equal index blobs (status shows staged-only modifications).
22	- Changed files: client.py (index blob 910e877), tests/test_client.py (index blob f1dfc4f).
23	- Pending: Task 2 provider receipts.
24	
25	## Existing behavior
26	- Entry point: client.save_settings(send, workspace_id, values, enhanced_settings=False).
27	- No other in-repo callers of save_settings besides tests/test_client.py (grep).
28	- Released provider (eval-release provider/settings.py, see historical bundle) stores
29	  request["settings"] and returns {"ok": True}; it does not read `require_receipt`
30	  and returns no `applied` key.
31	
32	## Delivery constraints
33	- Independently releasable main; client must support eval-release provider for
34	  ordinary saves with enhanced_settings false. No live environment.
35	
36	## Baselines
37	- Review base: HEAD ac09e55. Compatibility baseline: tag eval-release
38	  (22140737b2bc5792b535f3f8ce16f7fa162101db), source-level only.
39	
40	## Verification results
41	- No tests were executed by the parent for this review package. README test command:
42	  `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`. No author-supplied test results.
43	
44	## Rejected approaches
45	- None recorded.
